messages:
eva: quick review pls 1 1 1 — sample tiles in the new onboarding overlay. i pushed two variants: compact 3-up cards vs stacked list. goal: lower cognitive load on first-run, keep helpful microcopy, and meet a11y standards.
rahul: saw both. compact cards look modern but label legibility is meh on light backgrounds. maybe add subtle translucent panel behind text or increase weight.
noah: suggestion: show only 1-line description inline (max 35 chars) and reveal 2-line teaser on focus/hover. keeps vertical rhythm tight. Also ensure focus is visible in both themes.
clair: copy nit: top CTA says "Get started with sample" which is long. options: "Try sample", "Open sample", or "Launch demo". for new users "Try sample" feels lower friction.
eva: yeah, "Try sample" seems best. should we tag it with an info pill like "Sandbox"? might help set expectations that this won't affect production.
rahul: i like the pill but keep it visually subtle and screen-reader-only text for extra clarity: aria-label="sandbox sample project".
deploy-bot: deploy: branch feature/onboard-tiles -> staging. build 2026-03-23T15:12Z :shipit:
noah: keyboard interactions: arrow navigation inside the grid, Home/End to jump, space/enter to activate. must announce expanded teaser via aria-live or aria-describedby.
clair: accessibility checklist i want in the PR: contrast checks (AA for body, 3:1 for large text), focus ring 3px with visible offset, role=button on cards, aria-pressed for chosen, keyboard nav, min touch target 44px.
eva: quick css mock: ```css
.tile:focus { outline: 3px solid #0a66ff; outline-offset: 2px; }
.tile .label { font-weight: 600; color: #0F2330; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 6px; }
```
rahul: flip note: on narrow viewports the grid collapses to a single column and we should convert arrow nav to standard tab order + Enter. ensure role lived region reads the teaser when focused.
noah: copy drafts: compact label: "Starter: search assistant" teaser: "Preconfigured prompts, routing, and evals to explore search." (aim for ~50 chars). alternative: "Starter: support agent" with matching teaser.\e v a: (typo?) eva: updated figma with both copies and added focus state. PR will include screenshots and a11y checklist. rahul will run contrast checks and update styles. clair will finalize copy variants and test keyboard flow on staging. i'll open the PR by EOD and assign keyboard QA to noah.
noah: i'll test on ipad + NVDA on staging once deploy goes out. planning to check: tab/arrow behavior, screen reader announcements, focus visibility, and touch targets.
rahul: one last UX question: persist last-used sample tile in the console quick-access row after first run? pros: fast resume. cons: extra chrome. maybe show only one recent sample tile and a dismiss control.
clair: +1 to single recent tile with dismiss and an option in settings to hide. must be small and not push core routes down.
eva: sweet. next steps: rahul update CSS for contrast + bg panel, clair finalize copy + pill text, noah keyboard/a11y QA, i'll create the PR with checklist + screenshots. thanks everyone :pray:
